get.summary: Service health, including the database connection and its role, and whether new accounts can be made
The signed-in account and the device of this session; 401 without a session

post.summary: Ends this session and clears its cookies

get.summary: Options for a passkey sign-in, with a single-use challenge in a cookie

post.summary: Signs in with a passkey assertion and sets the session cookie
Options for a step-up bound to a purpose and an action, valid for 2 minutes
Verifies a step-up assertion; the approved action may then run once
Emails a registration link to the first account; 404 once an account exists or the code is not the configured one
Options for registering a link's passkey, with a single-use challenge in a cookie; 409 signed_in while a session exists
Registers the link's passkey, creating its account and signing it in

get.summary: Whether the account's recovery kit exists and was saved; never the code

post.summary: Issues the account part of a new recovery kit; the previous code stops working
Records that the person saved the recovery kit
Emails an invite valid for 48 hours; 403 account_unconfirmed until the account is confirmed, 409 too_many_invites past 10 open

get.summary: The signed-in account's open, accepted or confirmed invites, newest first

post.summary: Who sent an invite link, while it can still be accepted; 404 otherwise
Confirms the account that accepted an invite, after a step-up
Erases the account that accepted an invite, after a step-up

get.summary: The signed-in account's passkeys, oldest first, each with the live sessions it signed in; 401 without a session

post.summary: Ends one of the account's sessions, after a step-up; 403 step_up_required, 404 not_found

Removes one of the account's passkeys, or cancels a pending one, and ends every session it signed in, after a step-up; 403 step_up_required, 403 recovery_pending to any other passkey while a recovery passkey waits, 404 not_found, 409 last_active_passkey
Ends every session of the account but this one, after a step-up; 403 step_up_required
Creation options for another passkey of the account, after a step-up; 403 step_up_required
Stores the new passkey, pending for 24 hours; no session comes from it; 403 passkey_refused for every refusal
Emails a recovery link when the address has an account open to recovery; the same answer either way; 503 accounts_closed where no email can be sent
Exchanges the recovery code for a new one and opens the registration; 404 to a dead link, 403 invalid_code or recovery_locked

200.description: The new recovery code and the registration token

post.summary: Creation options for the recovery passkey of a redeemed link, with a 2-minute challenge; 404 to a link that is not redeemed or is dead
Stores the recovery passkey, pending for 24 hours, and restricts every session of the account meanwhile; no session comes from it; 403 passkey_refused, 404 to a dead link

get.summary: The signed-in account's audit events, newest first; 401 without a session

post.summary: Downloads everything the account owns as one JSON document, after a data_export step-up; 403 step_up_required
Ends every session and erases the account after the wait, after an account_deletion step-up; 403 step_up_required

delete.summary: Keeps the account whose deletion waits, after an account_deletion step-up; 403 step_up_required, 404 not_found

get.summary: Whether the account's vault is set up, and its current public recipient; 401 without a session

post.summary: Stores a new vault's recipient and envelopes, within a vault_unlock window; 403 step_up_required, 409 vault_exists, 400 invalid_request for a credential that is not an active passkey of the account

delete.summary: Deletes the vault's recipients, envelopes and sharing state, so it can be set up again, after a sensitive_settings step-up; 403 step_up_required, 404 not_found before set-up, 409 vault_has_documents while the account owns a document

get.summary: The vault's envelopes, within a vault_unlock window, recorded as fetched; 403 step_up_required, 404 not_found before the vault is set up

post.summary: Adds a passkey's envelope for the current recipient, within a vault_unlock window, keeping one already there; 403 step_up_required, 404 not_found before the vault is set up, 400 invalid_request for a credential that is not an active passkey of the account

Makes a new identity's recipient current, with its envelopes, and marks the old one rotated, keeping its envelopes, after a sensitive_settings step-up whose target is the rotated recipient and whose fields carry the new one; 403 step_up_required, 404 not_found before set-up, 409 vault_changed unless the recipient named is still current and the kept recovery envelopes name exactly the account's recipients, 409 sharing_state_changed unless the request re-tags exactly the stored sharing state's version, 400 invalid_request for a credential that is not an active passkey of the account

put.summary: Replaces every recovery envelope at once, so the old vault recovery secret opens none, after a sensitive_settings step-up whose targets are the recipient IDs in order; 403 step_up_required, 404 not_found before set-up, 409 vault_changed unless the list names exactly the account's recipients

get.summary: The account's sharing state as its device last stored it, for the device to verify; 401 without a session

put.summary: Stores the account's newly tagged sharing state, within a vault_unlock window, only over the version the device read; 403 step_up_required, 404 not_found before set-up, 409 vault_changed unless the recipient is the current one, 409 sharing_state_changed when another version was stored since

get.summary: The accounts linked to this one, each with its email and current vault recipient, in email order; 401 without a session
The account's notification channels and the push key; 401 without a session

post.summary: Adds this browser's push subscription, described from its User-Agent like a session, or returns the channel it already has; 409 too_many_push_channels past 10, 503 push_unavailable where push is not set up
Removes a push channel after a sensitive_settings step-up; 403 step_up_required, 404 not_found for an unknown or email channel

Adds a pending document and says where to upload its ciphertext; 401 without a session, 403 account_unconfirmed, 403 step_up_required outside a vault_unlock window, 404 not_found before the vault is set up, 409 document_quota past 300 documents or 1 GiB, 429 rate_limited

get.summary: The confirmed documents the account owns or that are shared with it, in document ID order, at most 50 a page; 401 without a session

post.summary: A presigned upload for one pending document's pathname, valid for 5 minutes and limited to its declared size; 401 without a session, 404 not_found unless the pathname is a pending document of the account created within the hour

Confirms a pending upload once the stored ciphertext has the declared size and SHA-256; any other ciphertext is deleted and the document stays pending until the daily cleanup; 401 without a session, 404 not_found, also 2 hours after create, 409 not_uploaded before the upload, 409 upload_mismatch, 429 rate_limited
A short-lived URL to one confirmed document's ciphertext, for its owner or a recipient, within the session's vault_unlock window; 401 without a session, 403 step_up_required, 404 not_found

Approves new ciphertext for confirmed documents the account owns, encrypted to the given linked accounts, and says where to upload each; for sharing, revoking and rotating; needs a consumed vault_write step-up for this exact request; 401 without a session, 403 step_up_required, 404 not_found unless every document is a confirmed one of the account, 409 not_linked for an account without a link, 409 document_quota

200.description: Where to upload each new ciphertext

post.summary: Swaps in each approved replacement whose upload has the approved size and SHA-256, and sets the document's shares to its recipients; deletes any other upload; not_found also for a replacement approved over 2 hours ago, not_linked when a recipient lost its link, which ends that replacement; one outcome per document, in order; 401 without a session, 429 rate_limited

Deletes documents the account owns, pending or confirmed, with their shares and ciphertext; needs a consumed vault_write step-up for this exact request; 401 without a session, 403 step_up_required, 404 not_found unless every document is one of the account
